title: Bihar DGP Calls For Meeting Over Sushant Singh Rajput Case | ABP News
description: Bihar DGP, Gupteshwar Pandey, has called for a high-level meeting today at 2 pm over the Sushant Singh Rajput case. Earlier, IPS Vinay Tiwari was quarantined when he reached Mumbai on Sunday in order to probe the death case of the actor. This was frowned upon by Bihar police. The DGP said that the IPS was forcibly put under isloation period whereas none else on the flight had to go through the process.  #BiharDGP #SushantCase #ABPNewsLive  To Subscribe our YouTube channel here: https://www.youtube.com/user/abpnewstv    Download ABP App for Apple: https://itunes.apple.com/in/app/abp-live-abp-news-abp-ananda/id811114904?mt=8  Download ABP App for Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.winit.starnews.hin&hl=en   About Channel: ABP News is a news hub which provides you with the comprehensive up-to-date news coverage from all over India and World. asr.full_text: The news is that the tension between the Bihar and Maharashtra police has increased to the point that the Bihar DGP Gupteswar Pande is due to hold a big meeting at the police headquarters at 2 pm today. Sources say that the Patna City SP request was copied by Bihar Police on being quarantined. So BMC allowed him to quarantine for 14 days. And when the incident was declared, it has now been directly raised. Prakash Kumar is on our phone line with our colleague and we know that Mr. Prakash is still questionable but asking and we have seen this before that it happens that the police of one state go to another state to check him out. He is not at the airport but he is called and he is asked by phone call where you are. This time it is beyond comprehension how the video will be supported by the interception. When postmortem report is not being given to Bihar police. The basic vests of the investigation are not being given to Bihar police. You have quarantined the SP. So how is the hope of the Bihar police will get support. Come with us in this maval. By video conferencing, Bihar Police is in contact with someone in Mumbai but I want to know with great interest what kind of conversation happened to an IPS officer when he arrived at the airport. You were with two other people who were not quarantined. You were told who contacted you. Tell me in detail. If you are saying these rules are government rules, then you will know in advance whether any Ad travelling must be quarantined or not. This means that the order was issued only for you because the two passengers you were with are not quarantined. I had no passengers with me, my team was already working on this date, they are sub-sugar. They are police officers so I came alone and I have no scratch. So Binne didn't understand what I meant, but I'll make a little money. You know who knows better than you. You know who knows better than you. You know who knows better than you. You know who knows better than you. You know who knows better than you. But now you have to make a appointment, but you believe that you want Mumbai Mumbai. But through BIMC, there are obstacles being created in your work, but administratively. So here your investigation will be on us and the difference is more so than there is Amari Investigation. So the speed was uncertain, the difference will be. So you keep growing with us in the meantime. We want to know what happened in this fight. I have informed my staff because we see the Daily Update. My opponents are getting out of the way. Wynn G. What did you say? Binne G. You know the sections of the IPC. You know what the law is being broken in this case and if the law is being broken, what the law is being molded according to it. I also want to know what you said to your officials and what you got back. If you don't want to use the word "I" on my visit, you can call it "hana". We are using the word "home quarantine". I am not calling it "home quarantine". I have a stamp of home quarantine. It clearly says that you are under the law of this order. So why not consider what is happening to you, Vinegi, to be legally wrong. You can call it "unfair" and not "unfair" to the police who are trying to influence the work of the police. No, this is not my way of doing things. Let's not take any auction on it, but something you have to do is make sure that your investigation doesn't go to waste. If the owner gets it, it depends on how much the investigation will go to waste. If it doesn't go to waste, you can't quantify it. But yes, it's that someone has been lured out of the country, so it's going to take a little bit of a little bit of a push to get the country back. If you have come to work in an office or are in an institutional post, then it has the full scope to get well. Let's go from Ayodhya to the development stay with us constantly because all the conversations are listening to development questions. Vinete Vary Ji, I have a question. You have been to Mumbai for government work in connection with non-government work. There is a section to interfere with government work of IPC 354. Have you been quarantined at home. So the meeting that will be held in Jopair today is going to be the one where the decision is going to be made whether you file an affidavit against BIMC. G. Chal Dev Dev is going to be with you. But as an IPS officer, Vinny Tiwari is going to be very clear about what you are saying. I understand that you are a government official and in a very unpretentious manner you are putting your words in front of the audience. But the audience needs to know that if this happens to them, you don't tell them what they want you to do. The hand you see on your TV screen is the hand of wife KSP Vinar Tiwari. And the seal you see on their hand is the BMC stamp of Mumbai which is proof that this IPS officer from Bihar has been quarantined in the name of Corona. SP without Tiwari Sushand case has arrived in Mumbai. He told BMC officials that he is on official duty. But still sent him to 14 days quarantine. But he was forcibly quarantined by the authorities at 11 pm. After constant urging, he was not allowed to stay in the IPS mosque. And now he is living in a guest house in the village of Gore. When the news came to Sushant 's family, he was also stranded. Sister Shweta Singirti wrote in a tweet that this is true. He had contested the 2009 election from the BJP and Jagan was the RUP of crimes. We will not tolerate the insults of Mumbai Police by the Maharashtra VJP leaders. Now there are elections in the wrong Bihar and the whole case is connected to Bihar so no one should be pissed. Tejasvi Yadav also got angry at the horrendous behavior of Bihar Police in Mumbai.
